race.comment: HOODYS HORSE (1) is racing well for this grade, no match when firmly in the market at Warrnambool last time but close up in a better race at Geelong two back. Up in trip again now should be fine and this looks very winnable. OCTAHEDRON (3) is in career-best form, winning two of his past three. Too good last time at Casterton and is capable of measuring up to this. HE'S ELECTRIC (5) won his maiden over this route two back and can bounce back off an even showing last start, he draws for every chance. PRINCE OF BYRON (4) hasn't gotten warm in two runs back but this is a lot easier than last start in town and his best is absolutely good enough.
